title: Round Percent
summary: Return part as a percentage of whole (whole is at least 1; part may be negative or larger than whole), rounded to the nearest whole number. Halves round away from zero: 12.5 becomes 13 and -12.5 becomes -13.
hints: Check what your language's round does with 2.5 and -2.5. Some round halves to the even number, some toward positive infinity, and some have no round at all.
part / whole * 100 is 14.499999999999998 for 29 and 200, because 0.145 has no exact binary form. Multiply before you divide, or stay in integers.
In integers: round the absolute value with (200 * |part| + whole) / (2 * whole), using integer division, then put the sign back. TypeScript: make sure a result of zero isn't -0.

cases.description: a half next to an even number
a negative half rounds away from zero
a half that floats get wrong
a tiny loss rounds to zero
